component.name: Internet Archive Uploader
component.summary: Upload files to the Internet Archive with a graphical queue

description.p: A graphical uploader for archive.org built on Qt. Drop multiple files, review the inferred media type, choose an item identifier and let the queue upload them with a configurable number of parallel transfers.
Authentication uses your own Internet Archive credentials stored in a local ia.ini; an HTTP proxy can be configured for networks that cannot reach archive.org directly.
